summary: Round 4 is a valid comparison with disclosed sleep-related censoring: before 16/100 versus installed 28/100 corrected wins. Continue the fixed final round without changing decks or repeating trials. The cumulative favorable result is nominal evidence, not proven improvement.
findings: Read AGENTS.md, the C17 brief, manifest, batch, prior JSON/Markdown reviews, runner and supervisor review-gate logic. Analyzed both completed summaries, all 200 game logs, original stdout files and parsed hand streams. Neither run has INVALID.txt or ABORTED.txt. No simulations, file modifications, purchases or engine changes were performed.

Controls verified: both source deck SHA256 values match the locked manifest; Forge-loaded copies match except Name. All frozen runtime files and all five opponent-group/schedule hashes match. Both round-4 trials.json files are byte-identical to trials-b4.json. All 100 trial IDs, pods, cases and seeds match in each arm; logs identify scheduled opponents in prescribed seats. The same respective locked decks were retained across rounds.

Both summaries record classesSha 601627412546ce7c, cardsSha 02c2b0e93031edd8 and the correct respective deck fingerprint. Independently recomputed classes fingerprint matches. Runner SHA256 remains ae37d38643cc55746f97064cfc26270f9c52d9c1ae52efe33b420521088d3d27. Runner code supplies identical scheduled seeds and seating, enables SMART_AI/POLITICS and clears listed extra tactics/full-state flags. These are artifact and execution-code checks, not independent per-process cryptographic attestations.

Before: 18 raw wins, 16 corrected wins, seven suspect scheduled draws and 93 clean finishes. Installed: 29 raw wins, 28 corrected wins, five suspect scheduled draws and 95 clean finishes. Both have 100 recorded results and zero external timeout markers. Independent winner-conflict and duration checks reproduce scoring. Clean-only rates are 16/93=17.2% versus 28/95=29.5%. Corrected/all-start nominal Wilson 95% intervals are 10.1–24.4% versus 20.1–37.5%.

Two genuine internal timeouts are backed by original stdout explicitly saying 'Stopping slow match as draw': before b4pod08-c5 reports 600011 ms and three winner lines; installed b4pod10-c5 reports 600014 ms and two winner lines. Both are synthetic timeout outcomes excluded as suspect draws, not ordinary simulated finishes. Neither records a raw player-1 win. Summary timeouts:0 means no external runner kill, not absence of internal timeouts.

Ten other duration suspects have one consistent winner, no slow-match stdout message and no external timeout marker. Before: b4pod03-c2 1462132 ms, b4pod03-c5 1924464, b4pod04-c1 2324187, b4pod04-c3 1183661, b4pod05-c3 2302201, b4pod05-c5 1216131. Installed: b4pod03-c1 4219296, b4pod03-c3 3941412, b4pod03-c4 2515785, b4pod04-c3 1435679. Read-only power logs show overlapping system sleep accounting for most of their hand-stream elapsed spans; approximate time outside recorded sleep ranges from 13 to 355 seconds. This supports sleep-related duration inflation, without establishing exact active execution time. Retain all exclusions under the predeclared >=600000-ms rule; do not label these ten synthetic timeouts or restore their three raw wins. The runner cannot guarantee elapsed-time termination across system sleep.

Round-4 shared clean pairing has 89 trials: both win eight, installed-only wins 17, before-only wins seven, neither wins 57. Thus before wins 15/89 and installed 25/89. Paired difference is +11.24 percentage points; nominal approximate 95% interval +0.70 to +21.77 points; exact two-sided McNemar p=0.0639. The approximate interval and exact test differ near the threshold; the exact test does not reject at 0.05. Pod dependence, AI timing, sleep-related censoring and repeated interim inspection limit inference.

By opponent group, corrected before/installed wins remain b1 25/26, b2 18/26, b3 12/19, b4 16/28, each out of 100 starts. Raw wins are respectively 27/28, 18/26, 12/21 and 18/29. Suspects are respectively 2/3, 1/0, 0/2 and 7/5. Cumulative corrected totals are 71/400=17.75% versus 99/400=24.75%; raw totals 75 versus 104, suspects ten per arm. Clean-only cumulative rates are 71/390=18.2% versus 99/390=25.4%. Group b5 is outside this review.

Across 383 cumulative shared clean trials: both win 31, installed-only wins 65, before-only wins 39, neither wins 248. Paired difference is +6.79 points, nominal approximate 95% interval +1.61 to +11.96 points; exact McNemar p=0.01384. This favorable nominal evidence is not a sequentially adjusted or pod-cluster-adjusted conclusion. Complete the predeclared series; do not rerun seeds or tune either arm.

Commander observations in each arm's clean games: before cast T'Challa in 86/93 games, with 129 cast events and 33 games containing recasts; installed in 94/95, with 145 events and 42 recast games. Median first cast was personal turn 3.5 versus 3. Recorded original-commander attack declarations were 208 versus 236; player combat damage totaled 967 versus 1346; blocker assignments against him were 59 versus 78; battlefield departures were 72 versus 82. Installed shows more commander activity and damage, but these unequal clean samples do not establish improved survival or continuous survival duration.

Clean logs record 369 versus 382 resolutions of the tapped-Vibranium creation description. Installed records 54 Mystic Forge activation declarations and eight Nettlecyst equip declarations. These establish artifact activity, not exact token inventories, mana production or individual causal contributions.

Added-card hand-exposure/cast-game counts across 95 clean installed games: Foundry Inspector 31/21; Clever Concealment 32/5; Path to Exile 21/16; Akroma's Will 33/23; Bronze Guardian 36/23; Mystic Forge 37/17; Winds of Abandon 32/24; Wurmcoil Engine 33/18; Nettlecyst 32/24; Forsaken Monument 33/21; Thousand Moons Smithy 28/14. Exposure includes opening/mulligan hands and is not necessarily a retained draw. Every addition was cast. Low casting frequency does not alone establish stranding or weakness. Mystic Forge retains its local AI:RemoveDeck:Random flag.

Concrete case 1, installed b4pod01-c2: after the opponent had already declined to block T'Challa, Akroma's Will resolved both modes. T'Challa dealt two four-point player hits, and recorded life rose 27→31→35. This demonstrates double strike and lifelink; flying did not cause that already-unblocked attack to connect. Installed won normally in 113745 ms; before lost normally in 18804 ms. This is an installed-only paired win, without isolating the spell as its sole cause.

Concrete case 2, installed b4pod08-c4: T'Challa died during Vanquish the Horde, was recast and destroyed by Abrupt Decay, then was recast again. A Human Soldier token later blocked his five-power attack. His subsequent battlefield departure occurred with Greater Good's five-card draw, not from the Soldier's one damage. With T'Challa absent, Akroma's Will supplied its first mode; Whispersilk Cloak equipped Invisible Woman, and Winds of Abandon exiled an Elephant. Invisible Woman then dealt two four-point hits for the normal win in 30735 ms. Before lost normally in 288938 ms. This shows rebuilding, an actual chump block, equipment reassignment and an army finish rather than commander survival.

Mana and pilot limits: before b4pod02-c2 recorded five land plays including Command Tower, Forest and Plains but never cast T'Challa; installed also failed to cast him despite land plays including Forest and Plains. Absence of a commander cast therefore cannot itself diagnose color screw. Case b4pod01-c2 records postcombat use of Vibranium's artifact-restricted mana, but mana-option text does not reveal exact payments. Full-state capture was disabled, so exact available mana, continuous survival, complete legal-blocking alternatives and reasons for held cards are unavailable. Protection timing, commander prioritization and equipment choices remain pilot limitations; card-conditioned wins are associations.

The comparison remains between authorized modeled lists: Divine Visitation in both and the disclosed assumed Mind's Eye cut for Forsaken Monument. It does not certify physical inventory or complete bracket legality. Ghostly Prison, Reconnaissance and Kutzil remain outside the locked arms. The supervisor checks structured reviewed:true and decision:continue before advancing; shared Markdown alone does not authorize continuation.
